name: irite
description: iRite support for Visual Studio Code

commands.title: iRite: Import 1280 Built-in Images from Firmware
commands.description: Import built-in images from a firmware update folder or rootfs.tar; reopen views to refresh

commands.title: iRite: Preview Screens
commands.description: Preview the 1280 screens of a Revolution .rev file (read-only)

commands.title: iRite: Edit Screens
commands.description: Opt-in editor for the 1280 screens: move and resize widgets and save x/y/width/height back into the .rev (a backup is written first)

commands.title: iRite: Regenerate main.iri from .rev
commands.description: Regenerate main.iri from the project's .rev (a backup of the previous main.iri is kept)

commands.title: iRite: Edit Database Schema
commands.description: Opt-in database schema editor for the project's .rev (backup first)

commands.title: iRite: Show Database Diagram
commands.description: Entity-relationship diagram of the iRite databases and the .rev schema (read-only)

commands.title: iRite: Show Sequence Diagram (SFC)
commands.description: Grafcet-style diagram of the STATES/TRANSITIONS state machine (read-only)

commands.title: iRite: Show Call Map
commands.description: Interactive C4-style map of how modules and routines call each other (read-only)

commands.title: iRite: Reset SFC Layout
commands.description: Delete the hand-made SFC layout of the project from .vscode/irite-sfc.layout.json and go back to the automatic layout

commands.title: iRite: Scaffold DB Access Routines
commands.description: Append stubs (marked TODO(irite-db): pending implementation) for the missing standard DB access routines of each table

commands.title: iRite: Export Pending DB Routines (JSON)
commands.description: Write the missing and pending DB access routines as JSON for an MCP/agent (schema irite.dbAccess.pending v1)

commands.title: iRite: Generate Project Docs
commands.description: Write Markdown documentation (ERD, SFC, screens, routines) to docs/generated/ (never touches .rev or sources)

irite.firmware.imagesVersion.description: Firmware image version to use. Empty or unavailable selects the latest imported version; reopen views after changing this setting.

irite.build.engine.description: Choose the build engine to be used

irite.build.enginePath.default: C:\Program Files (x86)\Rice Lake Weighing Systems\Revolution\iRite Editor\iRite_preprocessor.exe
irite.build.enginePath.description: Path to iRite_preprocessor.exe. On Linux/macOS, point this to the .exe as installed inside your Wine prefix (e.g. ~/.wine/drive_c/Program Files (x86)/...); the extension runs it via `wine` automatically.

irite.build.compilerPath.default: C:\Program Files (x86)\Rice Lake Weighing Systems\Revolution\iRite Editor\Compilers
irite.build.compilerPath.description: Path to the Compilers folder, as seen by the engine (Windows-style path, even under Wine on Linux/macOS)

irite.dbAccess.enabled.description: Warn on every database table that lacks the standard access routines (create/read/update/delete, record, per-field getters and setters, search).

irite.dbAccess.severity.description: Severity of the missing/pending DB access routines diagnostic.

irite.dbAccess.routinePrefix.description: Prefix of the expected routine names: <prefix><Table><Operation> (dbTransGetInWeight). May be empty (TransGetInWeight).

irite.dbAccess.exclusions.markdownDescription: Tables or groups the standard does not apply to. `Settings` excludes a whole table; `Settings:search` one group; `*:setters` a group of every table. Groups: `crud`, `record`, `getters`, `setters`, `search`. Case-insensitive.

irite.dbAccess.moduleFolder.description: Project-relative folder where the scaffold writes one module per table (<Table>.iri).

irite.dbAccess.exportPath.description: Project-relative file written by 'iRite: Export Pending DB Routines (JSON)'.

irite.editor.snap.description: Screen editor: snap dragged and resized widgets to the grid (can be toggled in the editor).

irite.editor.gridSize.description: Screen editor: grid size in 7 inch pixels used by snap and by Shift+arrow.

irite.sfc.statesEnum.description: Name of the enum holding the SFC steps. Empty = STATES.

irite.sfc.transitionsEnum.description: Name of the enum holding the SFC transitions. Empty = TRANSITIONS.

irite.sfc.initialStep.description: Initial SFC step. Empty = a step named Standby/Idle/Init, else the first one.

languageModelTools.name: irite_screens
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the screens of the iRite project .rev (screen numbers, names, widget counts).
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns, as JSON, the screens of a Rice Lake iRite (1280) project's .rev file: for each screen its number, names found in code and widget count, plus the indicator model. Read-only. Use it first to learn which screens exist before calling irite_widgets. Input: optional rev (path of a .rev or project folder inside the workspace).

rev.description: Path of the .rev file or of the iRite project folder (the one with main.rev / main.src), absolute or relative to the first workspace folder. Must be inside an open workspace folder. Optional: when omitted the project of the workspace is used; if there are several, pass it.

languageModelTools.name: irite_widgets
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the widgets of one iRite screen with their properties and boxes.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns, as JSON, the widgets of one screen of an iRite .rev in paint order: id, type, alias, caption, named catalog properties (props), authored 7-inch box, scaled panel box, backdrop and out-of-bounds flags, and the overlaps between widgets. Read-only. Use it to inspect a screen layout before suggesting changes. Input: optional rev, optional screen number (defaults to the lowest screen; large screens are truncated with a note) and optional panel 7 or 12.

rev.description: Path of the .rev file or of the iRite project folder (the one with main.rev / main.src), absolute or relative to the first workspace folder. Must be inside an open workspace folder. Optional: when omitted the project of the workspace is used; if there are several, pass it.

screen.description: Screen number to list. Optional: defaults to the lowest screen number (use irite_screens to list them).

panel.description: Panel for the scaled boxes: "7" (800x480, default) or "12" (1280x800).

languageModelTools.name: irite_diagnose
languageModelTools.userDescription: Report iRite problems: SFC, DB access routines and widget overlaps, including what the Problems panel shows.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns, as JSON, the iRite project diagnostics: SFC/Petri state machine problems (irite-sfc), missing DB access routines (irite-db-access) and widget overlaps or out-of-bounds widgets, with file, line and message, plus a 'live' section with the entries currently in the VS Code Problems panel from the iRite collections (irite-sfc entries exist only while the SFC diagram is open). Read-only. Use it to see what the user sees and to find what to fix. Input: optional rev (a .rev, main.src or project folder inside the workspace).

rev.description: Path of the .rev file or of the iRite project folder (the one with main.rev / main.src), absolute or relative to the first workspace folder. Must be inside an open workspace folder. Optional: when omitted the project of the workspace is used; if there are several, pass it.

languageModelTools.name: irite_dbSchema
languageModelTools.userDescription: List the database tables and fields stored in the iRite project .rev.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Returns, as JSON, the database tables defined in an iRite .rev (DB.SCHEMA / DB.ALIAS): table index, name, max records and each field with name, Revolution type name, numeric type code and size. Read-only. Use it before suggesting database or dbaccess changes. Input: optional rev (path of a .rev or project folder inside the workspace).

rev.description: Path of the .rev file or of the iRite project folder (the one with main.rev / main.src), absolute or relative to the first workspace folder. Must be inside an open workspace folder. Optional: when omitted the project of the workspace is used; if there are several, pass it.

languageModelTools.name: irite_widgetSet
languageModelTools.userDescription: Change properties on an existing .rev widget by numeric ID.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Change properties on an existing .rev widget by numeric ID. Preview by default. Set apply=true only when the user asks to apply the change; VS Code then asks for per-call confirmation.

rev.description: Path to a .rev or iRite project folder inside the workspace; omit for a single project.

apply.description: Default false: preview only. True requests a native VS Code confirmation and then applies only if approved.

id.description: Numeric widget ID; list widgets first if unknown.

fields.description: Widget property assignments as individual key=value strings.
